historical_references.reference: Hiyaavi was a renowned temple dancer in the royal court of Thanjavur Maratha Kingdom in the 18th century. Her real name was Devasenapathi Amma. She was renowned for her exceptional dance skills and had the unique ability to move the deity in the temple to tears.
